title: Personal Upgrades
description: System where players can customize their stats
body:
Personal Upgrades is a datapack that adds a system for players to customize their character's stats by exchanging experience levels.

Character's Stats

Some players would want to feel more stronger than their resources can provide, so by using your experience levels, you can gain/lose (currently) health, armor, and speed up to 10 times! By using /trigger PU-UpgradesMenu, you are able to access the menu where you can change your stats.

Upgrades

+/- 2 Max Health (1 Heart)

+/- 2 Armor (1 Armor Point)

+/- 0.005 Movement Speed
